title: Parse and build query strings
prompt: Implement parse(qs) and stringify(obj) in qs.js. parse ignores a leading '?', splits on '&' and skips empty pairs, splits each pair at its first '=', decodes percent escapes and '+' as a space in keys and values, gives '' for a key without '=', and collects a repeated key into an array of its values in order (a key seen once is a string). stringify writes keys in sorted order, an array as the key repeated once per value, skips undefined values, encodes with encodeURIComponent but writes spaces as '+', and returns '' for an empty object. Do not change test.js.
